#!/usr/bin/env bash
# .git/hooks/commit-msg
msg=$(cat "$1")
pattern='^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore|perf)(\(.+\))?: .{1,80}$'

if ! echo "$msg" | grep -qE "$pattern"; then
  echo "commit msg must follow conventional commits:"
  echo "  feat(scope): short description"
  exit 1
fi
